primary_risk: Unauthorized access to remediation role could lead to broad AWS account compromise.
likely_attack_path: Compromise member account -> Create malicious Security Hub finding -> Exploit broad permissions in RemediationRole -> Access or modify resources
security_signals: Creation of multiple Security Hub findings from a single account
Unexpected changes in AWS resource configurations
investigation_goals: Identify the source of unauthorized IAM activity in the RemediationRole
Trace the sequence of events leading to the exploitation of the RemediationRole
Review and tighten permissions associated with the RemediationRole
recommended_evidence_sources: CloudWatch logs for AWS Config changes
hidden_truth_candidates: The remediation role's broad permissions were configured using AWS managed policies without proper review.
